display.purpose: Main editor heading; reduces in size on narrow phones.

label.purpose: Compact upload, camera, and primary action labels.

motion.name: control-state
motion.purpose: Border, background, and transform feedback on controls.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Disable transitions and smooth scrolling when requested.

breakpoints.name: compact-mobile
breakpoints.purpose: Tighten gutters and controls; make the primary action full width.

components.name: Primary action
components.description: Starts generation after a photo is selected.
components.css: .ds-button { min-height:42px; border:1px solid #d7262d; border-radius:3px; background:#d7262d; color:#fff; padding:10px 16px; font:700 13px "DM Sans",sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:background .15s,transform .15s } .ds-button:hover { background:#b91f26; transform:translateY(-1px) } .ds-button:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #b676d1; outline-offset:3px } .ds-button:disabled { border-color:#aeb7c3; background:#aeb7c3; cursor:not-allowed; transform:none }

components.name: Photo input actions
components.description: Separate upload and camera entry points below the photo stage.
components.css: .ds-photo-actions { display:flex; gap:8px; margin-top:10px } .ds-photo-actions button { min-height:42px; flex:1; border:1px solid #d5dbe3; border-radius:3px; background:#fff; color:#0d1b3d; padding:10px 16px; font:700 13px "DM Sans",sans-serif } .ds-photo-actions button:hover { border-color:#0d1b3d; background:#f6f7f8 } .ds-photo-actions button:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #b676d1; outline-offset:3px }

components.name: Inline camera controls
components.description: Capture or cancel after the visitor opens a live camera preview.
components.css: .ds-camera-controls { display:flex; gap:8px; margin-top:10px } .ds-camera-controls button { min-height:42px; border:1px solid #d5dbe3; border-radius:3px; background:#fff; color:#0d1b3d; padding:10px 16px; font:700 13px "DM Sans",sans-serif } .ds-camera-controls button:first-child { border-color:#d7262d; background:#d7262d; color:#fff } .ds-camera-controls button:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #b676d1; outline-offset:3px }

components.name: Edit choice
components.description: A named, selectable photo treatment with no category tag.
components.css: .ds-choice { width:100%; min-height:61px; border:1px solid #d5dbe3; background:#fff; color:#152442; border-radius:3px; padding:9px 11px; display:grid; grid-template-columns:18px minmax(0,1fr); align-items:center; gap:10px; text-align:left; cursor:pointer; transition:border-color .15s,background .15s } .ds-choice:hover { border-color:#8796ac; background:#fafbfc } .ds-choice[aria-pressed="true"] { border:2px solid #d7262d; padding:8px 10px; background:#fffafa } .ds-radio { width:15px; height:15px; border:1px solid #8797a9; border-radius:50% } .ds-choice[aria-pressed="true"] .ds-radio { border:4px solid #d7262d } .ds-choice:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #b676d1; outline-offset:3px } .ds-choice strong, .ds-choice small { display:block } .ds-choice strong { color:#0d1b3d; font:700 13px "DM Sans",sans-serif } .ds-choice small { margin-top:2px; color:#58677d; font:400 12px/1.35 "DM Sans",sans-serif }

components.name: Workspace panel
components.description: Flat white container for the source and controls or the edited result.
components.css: .ds-panel { min-width:0; background:#fff; border:1px solid #d5dbe3; padding:19px; border-radius:4px }

narrative.overview:
SafeFrame turns one photo edit into a short, legible trip: choose a source, select one treatment, and collect the finished image. The ticket-wallet reference contributes its navy and red identity, condensed display type, crisp dividers, and a compact journey. Travel language is an organizing cue, not a layer of invented travel facts.

The two-panel workspace keeps the source and its edit controls together on the left while the result remains visible on the right from the first desktop view. On mobile, the hierarchy collapses into one column, with the source and edit choices before the result. Upload and camera capture are separate, equally clear ways to provide a photo; camera preview and capture controls appear inline only after the visitor starts the camera.
keyCharacteristics: A short, ordered choose → edit → collect flow without progress navigation.
A restrained carrier palette with red reserved for the primary action and selected edit.
Standard, legible photo controls inside a crisp, low-depth layout.

rules.name: The Two-Panel First View Rule
rules.body: Keep the source and edit controls together on the left, with the result pane visible on the right from the first desktop view.

rules.name: The Ticket Cue Rule
rules.body: Use travel language to organize the short edit journey; do not invent flight facts or let decorative travel details obscure photo controls.

dos: Do keep the desktop source-and-controls panel beside a visible result panel from the first view.
Do keep the three edit modes distinct and selectable before generation.
Do give upload and camera capture separate, equally visible actions.
Do retain the visible focus treatment and reduced-motion behavior.
donts: Don't turn the editor into a feed, gallery, or stack of decorative upload cards.
Don't add invented flight information or travel facts to the ticket-wallet metaphor.
Don't reintroduce progress navigation, tag labels, taglines, or redundant status captions that compete with the photo and edit controls.
